newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE -- LaGrange, Ga., agency.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- LaGrange, Ga., agency.

text.p: of The City of LaGrange, Georgia
The Solid Waste Management Authority of the City of
LaGrange (the Authority'') will receive sealed bids at the
City's Manger's Conference Room, 200 Ridley Avenue,

no later than 11:00 a.m., Atlanta local time, for the purchase of $8,070,000* in aggregate principal amount of the Authority's Revenue Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds''). The Authority may, however, postpone the date established for the receipt of bids. The Authority will communicate any such changes in the sale date through Munifacts News Service not less than 24 hours prior to the time bids are to be received.

Proposals for the purchase of the Bonds must be for all of the Bonds, must be submitted on the Official Bid Form referred to below, and must conform to the terms and conditions set forth in the Official Notice of Sale referred to below. The Authority will publicly open and read the bids at the time, place, and date set forth above.

The Official Notice of Sale referred to below sets forth a description of the Bonds, which will mature serially in the years 1999 through 2012, inclusive. The Authority reserves the right to modify or amend the Official Notice of Sale. The Authority will communicate any such changes through Munifacts News Service by 3:00 p.m. on Monday, August 11, 1997.

The Bonds are limited obligations of the Authority payable solely from payments made by the City of LaGrange (the City'') pursuant to an Intergovernmental Contract, dated as of June 1, 1997, between the Authority and the City. The City has agreed to levy an ad valorem tax, within such limits now or hereafter prescribed by law, on all property located in the City subject to such tax as may be necessary to pay the principal of, premium (if any) and interest on the Bonds.

The approving opinion of King &Spalding, Atlanta, Georgia, Bond Counsel, will be furnished to the successful bidder at the expense of the Authority upon the delivery of the Bonds. This announcement does not constitute the solicitation of bids to purchase the Bonds. The sale of the Bonds shall be made exclusively pursuant to the terms of the Official Notice of Sale. Copies of the Preliminary Official

Statement, the Official Notice of Sale, and the Official Bid Form may be obtained from the Authority's Financial Advisor, Knox, Wall &Company, 400 Tower Place, 3340 Peachtree Road, N.E., Atlanta, Georgia 30326, Phone: (404) 231-4711 and Fax: (404) 262-3093.
